user.title: Create Notification Catalog
user.description: A catalog holds reusable light groups and notification rules.

init.title: Notify Lights
init.description: Light groups answer **where** a notification appears. Notification rules answer **when** it appears and **what** it looks like.

add_group.title: Add Light Group
add_group.description: Create a reusable destination such as “Common alerts,” “Near garage,” or “Outside office.” Areas and Home Assistant light groups are supported. Use Except for patterns such as the whole house except kids’ rooms. If the same switches are also in a Zigbee2MQTT group, enter its friendly name to send one reliable groupcast instead of many device commands.

modify_group_form.title: Edit Light Group
modify_group_form.description: Changing this group updates every notification rule that uses it. A Zigbee2MQTT group must contain exactly the same switches selected here.

add_notification.title: Add Notification Rule
add_notification.description: Choose a plain-language activation behavior. Automatic rules can follow a state for as long as it is true, or start a timed notification when that state is entered.

modify_notification_form.title: Edit Notification Rule
modify_notification_form.description: Renaming changes the display name only; the entity ID remains stable.

notification_source.title: Choose the State Source
notification_source.description: Select the Home Assistant entity that represents this condition. Next you'll choose its main state or a specific attribute, such as a climate entity's hvac_action.

notification_property.title: Choose What to Watch
notification_property.description: Watch the entity's main state, or choose one of its attributes. Current values are shown to make the choice understandable without looking in Developer Tools.

notification_details.title: Route and Style the Notification
notification_details.description: Choose reusable light groups, optional extra lights, and the LED appearance. Higher-priority notifications win when several are active on the same switch. Priority 30 or lower always has a one-pixel footprint in the stack, regardless of the selected coverage.

error.name_exists: A record with this name already exists.
error.invalid_name: Enter a name containing at least one letter or number.
error.target_required: Choose at least one light group or additional target.
error.group_in_use: This light group is used by a notification rule. Edit that rule before deleting the group.
